reuse.why: Extends the existing isNonWorkingDay helper, which every holiday-aware path (getDateWithSkippedWeekend, findWeekdayOccurrence, the schedule handlers) already calls, using monthUtils.dayFromDate.

duplication.why: The new matching rule is written once inside the shared predicate; nothing is duplicated.

placement.why: The holiday rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, where the tree already decides what a non-working day is.

scope.why: A three-line change to one function plus a release note; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Small and clear with a comment on the two formats; the format detection relies on day.slice(5) and has no test in the diff, but it is easy to follow.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks go through isNonWorkingDay.
